$schema: ./manifest.schema (see README.md for the per-file frontmatter schema)

components.summary: Vertically stacked, expandable sections that reveal or hide long content to keep a dense view scannable.

replaces: custom stacked 'ver más' blocks without a shared pattern

not_to_confuse_with.why: Collapsible is a single region; Accordion is multiple stacked sections
Tabs switch views; Accordion stacks disclosable content

components.summary: An inline, persistent contextual message that stays in the page flow until the user resolves or dismisses it.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Snackbar is floating + ephemeral; Alert is inline + persistent
Alert Dialog blocks and demands a choice; Alert coexists with content
Badge is a compact read-only status marker; Alert is a full contextual message

components.summary: A layout primitive that locks content to a fixed width:height ratio while the width stays fluid — for media, thumbnails, and embeds.

replaces: padding-bottom percentage hacks for intrinsic ratio boxes

not_to_confuse_with.why: Avatar is a fixed person circle; Aspect Ratio is a fluid-width media box
Skeleton is the loading placeholder; Aspect Ratio reserves the final media's shape

source.css: layout primitive — no dedicated css/components file; uses the native CSS aspect-ratio property

components.summary: A compact file row showing an icon/thumbnail, name and metadata, with an optional remove action, upload progress, or error state.

not_to_confuse_with.why: input chips are compact removable tokens; Attachment is a file row with metadata + progress
the <input type=file> does the picking; Attachment displays the result

components.summary: A circle showing a person's photo or initials over a brand tonal fill — identifies a person, never a non-person entity.

replaces: hardcoded-gradient initial divs / ad-hoc profile circles

not_to_confuse_with.why: Badge is read-only status text; Avatar identifies a person
skeleton-circle is the loading placeholder for an avatar, not an avatar

components.summary: A read-only pill communicating an item's status, category, or a count — each color carries a fixed meaning; never interactive.

not_to_confuse_with.why: chips are interactive (filter/select/remove); a badge is read-only status
buttons act; a badge only informs
alert is a persistent inline message block; a badge is a compact status pill

components.summary: A hierarchy trail showing where the user is and letting them jump back to an ancestor.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Back Link is a single 'volver'; Breadcrumb is a multi-level trail
Navigation is primary wayfinding; Breadcrumb shows location
Pagination pages through a set; Breadcrumb shows hierarchy

components.summary: A container that visually joins related buttons (or an input + addon) into one unit by collapsing shared borders and radii — it carries no selection state of its own.

tokens.radius: --radius-* inherited from the child buttons; inner corners collapse to 0
tokens.spacing: children share a single 1px border (no gap between joined members)

replaces: rows of adjacent buttons with hand-tuned radius overrides

not_to_confuse_with.why: segmented picks 1 of N with persistent selected state; button group has no selection
toggle-group holds stateful on/off toggles; button group holds plain actions

components.summary: Triggers an action. Chosen by hierarchy (color) and density (size); exactly one primary action per context.

replaces: a flat 'action row' → map to a hierarchical button group

not_to_confuse_with.why: chips filter/select/represent input; buttons perform actions
segmented switches a view/mode; button acts once
badge is a read-only status; not interactive

components.summary: A month-grid date/range picker with real month/year navigation — the base of the Date Picker, usable inline or docked in a popover, dialog, or sheet.

replaces: ad-hoc date pickers without an accessible grid

not_to_confuse_with.why: Select picks month/year or a bounded option; Calendar picks a specific day/range
Popover is the container; the Date Picker is Calendar docked inside one

components.summary: A rich content panel that groups content and actions about a single subject on a surface.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Basic Card (item) is a compact row primitive; Full Card is a rich multi-part panel
Stat Card shows a single KPI; Full Card groups general content
specialized domain card; Full Card is generic

components.summary: A scroll-snapping, browsable set of homogeneous items (images or cards) with prev/next controls — for secondary content that doesn't fit in one row.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Tabs switch between distinct panels; Carousel browses one homogeneous collection
Scroll Area is free scroll; Carousel snaps to discrete items with controls
compare options in a grid/Table, not a carousel

components.summary: Line, area, bar, and pie visualizations for dashboards and analytics — hand-drawn inline SVG + CSS conic-gradient, themed with the --chart-1..5 categorical palette.

replaces: static image charts, custom canvas, or charting libs with no theming

not_to_confuse_with.why: Stat Card shows one metric; Charts show a series/comparison/composition
Table gives exact per-row values; a chart shows the shape of the data

components.summary: A native checkbox for selecting one or more options from a set — three states (unchecked / checked / indeterminate); the change applies on confirm, not instantly.

not_to_confuse_with.why: radio is exclusive single choice; checkbox is independent multi-select
switch applies instantly; checkbox applies on confirm
chips are inline toolbar filters; checkboxes are form-level selection

components.summary: A compact, interactive element for filtering, selecting, or representing input — never for primary actions.

not_to_confuse_with.why: badge is read-only status; chip is interactive
segmented is single-select view switch; filter chips are usually multi-select
buttons act; chips filter/select/represent input

components.summary: A single show/hide region toggled by any trigger — a minimal disclosure with one boolean state.

replaces: ad-hoc display:none toggles without transition or accessible state

not_to_confuse_with.why: Accordion is multiple stacked sections; Collapsible is a single region

components.summary: A searchable single-select — a trigger button that opens a filterable Command list; pick one value from a long set by typing to narrow it.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Select has no typeahead; use it for short lists
Command runs commands / navigates (⌘K); Combobox picks a form value
chips represent multi-select tokens; Combobox is single-select

components.summary: A searchable command palette / filterable list — substring-filtered items with arrow/Enter navigation and an empty state, optionally opened as a ⌘K Command Dialog.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Search queries app content/results; Command runs commands / navigates
Select picks one value from a short bounded list; Command is a searchable command surface
Combobox is a single-value form field built ON the Command filter; Command is the palette itself

components.summary: A cursor-anchored actions menu opened by right-click (or long-press) on an element — the same panel as Dropdown Menu, just a different trigger.

replaces: custom position:fixed context menus with ad-hoc z-index

not_to_confuse_with.why: Dropdown Menu opens from a visible trigger on click; Context Menu opens at the cursor on right-click
Navigation Menu moves between sections; Context Menu acts on an element

components.summary: An interactive table over static Table — column sort, text filter, row selection, column visibility, and slice pagination via initDataTable().

not_to_confuse_with.why: Table is static; Data Table adds sort/filter/selection/pagination
List is a simple vertical list, not a comparable-columns grid

components.summary: A modal surface that interrupts the user for a focused task or a decision that must be resolved before continuing.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Sheet is edge-anchored (filters/detail); Dialog is centered/modal task
Snackbar is transient non-blocking feedback
Alert is persistent inline messaging, not modal

components.summary: A 1px line that separates groups of equal-hierarchy content — the lightest separation in the system, no brand color, no elevation.

replaces: unstyled <hr> / ad-hoc CSS borders between sections

not_to_confuse_with.why: a Card frames/contains content; a Divider only draws a separating line

components.summary: A centered icon + message (+ optional primary action) shown when there is no content to display — always offering a clear way out, not just a message.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Skeleton = data loading; Empty State = no data exists
Alert = inline error/warning message; Empty State = no-content placeholder
Placeholder = feature under construction; Empty State = feature works but has no data

components.summary: The layout + validation pattern that composes labels, controls, hints, and errors into an accessible form using native HTML5 validation.

replaces: ad-hoc form markup with inconsistent label/error handling

not_to_confuse_with.why: a dialog may contain a form; the form is the field/validation pattern itself
toolbar filters a list in place; a form collects and submits input

components.summary: Joins an input with adjacent addons — icons, text, units, or buttons — into a single bordered unit that shares one focus/error state.

replaces: ad-hoc absolute-positioned icon/button wrappers around inputs

not_to_confuse_with.why: input is the plain field; input-group adds joined addons
toolbar arranges independent controls; input-group is one field

components.summary: One-time-code / PIN entry in individual single-character boxes, with auto-advance, backspace-back, and paste-splitting.

replaces: N loose <input> code fields without auto-advance/paste-splitting

not_to_confuse_with.why: input is free-form; OTP is fixed-length per-character code entry

components.summary: A single-line text field for free-form entry, with label, hint, error, and optional leading/trailing icons.

not_to_confuse_with.why: textarea is multi-line; input is single-line
search fields query content; inputs capture form values
select picks from a fixed list; input is free-form

components.summary: The reusable compact-row primitive — media + content (title/description) + actions — that every compact domain card is built on.

replaces: ad-hoc flex divs with icon + text + button

not_to_confuse_with.why: Full Card is a rich multi-part panel; Basic Card is a compact row
List is a simpler homogeneous headline+supporting list; Item is a richer, media-capable row primitive
Table aligns comparable columns across rows; Item is a self-contained row

components.summary: A compact draggable card representing one item (candidate or vacancy) on a kanban board column, where the item's current stage is the primary information.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Vacancy Card is a rich list row; Kanban Card is a compact board tile
Table compares attributes across records; the board tracks stage
Basic Card is a generic compact row; Kanban Card adds drag/board semantics

components.summary: A standalone styled <label> for any form control, especially non-text controls, decoupled from the text-input field-group.

replaces: unstyled <label> or a <span> acting as a label

not_to_confuse_with.why: the text-input label is .field-label in .field-group; .label is the standalone/non-text-control label
badge is read-only status; a label names an interactive control

components.summary: A simple vertical list of homogeneous items, each with a headline and optional supporting text, leading and trailing slots.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Basic Card (item) is a richer, media-capable row primitive; List is a simpler homogeneous list
Table aligns comparable columns; List is a single-column vertical set
Navigation is app-level wayfinding; List is content

components.summary: Loading indicators that signal an operation is in progress — a determinate Progress bar/ring when a percentage is known, an indeterminate Spinner when it isn't.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Skeleton mimics the incoming layout's shape; Loading is an abstract activity indicator
Empty State handles no-data; Loading handles in-progress

components.summary: A trigger-anchored floating surface — a Dropdown Menu for a keyboard-navigable list of actions, or a Popover for freeform contextual content.

replaces: custom position:absolute dropdowns with ad-hoc z-index

not_to_confuse_with.why: Select picks one value for a form field; a menu triggers actions
Context Menu is right-click/long-press anchored to the cursor; Dropdown is a click on a visible trigger
Popover is freeform content; Dropdown Menu is a keyboard-navigable action list (both here, chosen by content)
Tooltip is a passive label; menu/popover are interactive

components.summary: A horizontal, always-visible bar of top-level triggers (Archivo, Editar…), each opening an actions panel — the desktop-application menu pattern.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Navigation Menu navigates between sections; Menubar issues app commands
Dropdown Menu is one contextual menu; Menubar is a persistent row of them
Toolbar exposes controls directly; Menubar nests commands under category triggers

components.summary: The app-shell sidebar rail — the persistent list of top-level destinations (icon + label) that anchors primary navigation on desktop.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Nav Drawer is this same rail in its compact modal form
Navigation Menu is flyout menus off a bar, not the app-shell rail
Toolbar hosts view controls/filters, not navigation
Tabs switch sub-views within one screen; the rail switches top-level destinations

components.summary: A documentation-shell-only navigation card that links into sections of the docs site — NOT part of the consumable library.

tokens.note: Docs-chrome styles inline in index.html — no css/components token contract to import.

replaces: ad-hoc navigation cards inside the docs site

not_to_confuse_with.why: Full Card is the consumable product panel; Nav Card is docs chrome
Stat Card shows a metric in product UI; Nav Card links docs sections
Basic Card (item) is the consumable compact row; Nav Card is docs-only

source.css: (docs-internal — no css/components file; styles inline in index.html)

components.summary: The app-shell sidebar in its compact form — below 768px it becomes a modal, off-canvas drawer that slides in over a scrim, toggled by the topbar hamburger.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Nav Bar is the same sidebar in its persistent desktop form; Nav Drawer is its modal compact form
Side Sheet holds content (filters/detail); the drawer holds primary navigation
Navigation Menu is flyout menus off a bar, not the app shell

components.summary: A horizontal row of navigation triggers that reveal grouped-link flyout panels — the top-nav mega-menu pattern.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Menubar issues app commands; Navigation Menu moves between sections
Dropdown Menu lists actions; Navigation Menu lists destinations
Tabs switch views within one page; Navigation Menu goes between pages/sections

components.summary: Navigate between pages of a paged result set — previous/next, numbered pages, and an ellipsis for large ranges.

replaces: 'cargar más' controls when the total is known and bounded

not_to_confuse_with.why: Data Table embeds slice pagination; standalone Pagination is the control itself
Breadcrumb shows hierarchy/location, not page-through of a set

components.summary: A documented Person variant of Basic Card (Item) — a compact profile row (brand avatar + name + role); NOT a separate component.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Person Card IS the Item primitive with a brand avatar — not a distinct component
Vacancy Card is for jobs; Person Card is for people
Avatar is just the image/initials; Person Card is the whole profile row

components.summary: A native radio group for an exclusive single choice among 2–5 mutually exclusive values, all visible at once for comparison.

not_to_confuse_with.why: checkbox is independent multi-select; radio is exclusive single choice
select hides options behind a trigger for larger sets; radio shows 2–5 at once
a pill view-switch is Segmented Button, not a radio group
switch is an instant on/off; radio is a deliberate single choice

components.summary: A scroll container with a discreet, consistent custom scrollbar — pure CSS, for overflow regions inside a panel, menu, or sheet.

replaces: the default browser scrollbar inside panels/menus

not_to_confuse_with.why: Carousel is snap-scrolling of discrete items with prev/next; Scroll Area is a free-scroll region
table horizontal overflow uses .table-scroll, not scroll-area

components.summary: Free-text search of content, in two official variants — a standalone pill Search Bar (mobile/hero) and a compact Search Field inside a Toolbar (desktop).

replaces: the retired toolbar search-field pattern (now formalized as .search-field)

not_to_confuse_with.why: combobox returns a chosen value from a list; search queries free-text content
command is the ⌘K palette for actions/navigation; search finds content
input captures a form value; search queries content and carries role=search

components.summary: A compact pill that switches between 2–5 mutually exclusive views or modes; exactly one segment is active at a time.

tokens.component: MD3 component-token tier --seg-btn-* (each with var(--md-sys-color-X, var(--color-X)) fallback); resolve via css/md-sys-bridge.css

not_to_confuse_with.why: tabs navigate between panels/sections; segmented switches a view/mode in place
toggle-group is a row of independent button toggles (bold/italic); segmented is a bordered pill view-switch
chips are multi-select tag filters; single-select segmented always keeps one active
buttons act once; segmented selects a persistent mode

components.summary: Choose exactly one option from a short-to-medium bounded list via a themed dropdown listbox.

replaces: legacy dropdowns / unstyled native selects where theming matters

not_to_confuse_with.why: combobox filters by typing; select is a fixed pick-one list
dropdown-menu triggers actions; select captures a form value
radio shows all options at once for a few choices

components.summary: An edge-anchored modal panel that slides up from the bottom for quick actions or supplementary content — the preferred overlay on mobile/compact.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Dialog is centered/modal; Bottom Sheet is edge-anchored, mobile-first
Side Sheet anchors to a lateral edge for desktop filters/detail
Nav Drawer is primary navigation, not a content panel

components.summary: An edge-anchored modal panel that slides in from a lateral (or top) edge for filters, item detail, or secondary forms — the desktop counterpart of the Bottom Sheet.

replaces: legacy side-sheet / drawer for content panels

not_to_confuse_with.why: Dialog is centered/modal; Side Sheet is edge-anchored filters/detail
Bottom Sheet is the mobile-first, bottom-anchored variant
Nav Drawer is primary navigation, not a content panel

components.summary: An animated shimmer placeholder that mimics the layout of content while data loads — for loads with a known structure, in place of ad-hoc spinners.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Empty State = no data exists; Skeleton = data is loading
Progress/Spinner shows indeterminate or measured progress; Skeleton mimics the awaited layout

components.summary: Selects a value (or a range) within a continuum with immediate feedback — for values where the exact number matters little.

not_to_confuse_with.why: progress is read-only status; slider is an interactive input
input captures exact typed values; slider is approximate

components.summary: A floating, ephemeral, non-blocking message that confirms something already happened, with at most one recovery action.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Alert is inline + persistent; Snackbar is floating + ephemeral
Dialog blocks and demands a decision; Snackbar never blocks
Toast (.toast panel) is the top-right system notification with a semantic icon; Snackbar is the bottom inverse-surface confirmation bar

components.summary: A single KPI/metric with a label, a large value, and an optional trend indicator.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Full Card groups general content; Stat Card is a single metric
Chart shows a trend over many points; Stat Card is one value + delta

components.summary: A binary on/off control with immediate effect — flipping it applies the setting instantly, no separate confirm button.

replaces: a checkbox styled as a switch without role=switch

not_to_confuse_with.why: checkbox is a deferred-submit selection; switch applies instantly
toggle is a pressable state button (e.g. bold); switch is a setting
radio picks one of several; switch is a single binary

components.summary: Static tabular data — records with multiple comparable attributes in rows and columns, with an optional clickable-row variant.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Data Table adds sort/filter/selection/pagination; Table is static
List is a simple 1–2 attribute vertical list; Table compares columns

components.summary: Switch between mutually exclusive views of the same entity, showing one panel at a time.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Segmented switches a compact view/mode; Tabs organize panels of content
Navigation moves between pages; Tabs stay within one page
Accordion stacks expandable sections; Tabs show one panel at a time

components.summary: A multi-line text field for paragraph-length free-form input, with the same label/hint/error language as Input.

not_to_confuse_with.why: input is single-line; textarea is multi-line
input-group joins addons to a single-line control

components.summary: A set of related Toggles on one axis — multi-select (each independent) or single-select (choosing one deselects the rest); deliberately distinct from Segmented Button.

not_to_confuse_with.why: segmented is a bordered pill view-switch (always 1 active, view labels); toggle-group is a row of button toggles (formats/filters)
chips are tag-style filters below a search/toolbar; toggle-group toggles share one axis
Switch is a single labelled on/off; toggle-group is a set

components.summary: A single two-state (pressed / not-pressed) button for a bold-style setting that applies immediately — state lives on aria-pressed.

replaces: ad-hoc on/off buttons with hand-managed aria-pressed

not_to_confuse_with.why: Switch is a labelled on/off preference; Toggle is a bold-style button
chips are tag-style multi-select filters; a toggle is a single setting button
segmented picks 1 of N views; a toggle is one independent on/off
buttons act statelessly; a toggle holds an on/off state

components.summary: The row of controls that heads a list or table — a compact search field plus filters, sorting, and the view's single primary action.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Top Bar is app chrome + global actions; Tool Bar controls one list/table
Page Header titles the content; the Tool Bar carries its controls
the standalone Search Bar heads a whole screen; the Tool Bar uses the compact search-field

components.summary: A small hover/focus text label that clarifies an ambiguous control — plus a click-triggered Rich Tooltip for a title + text + action preview. Never for essential information.

replaces: a separate Hover Card (dropped — Rich Tooltip covers it)

not_to_confuse_with.why: Popover holds interactive/arbitrary content; tooltip is a passive label/preview
Dialog is modal/blocking; tooltip never blocks

components.summary: The app-shell header for each view — surfaces navigation context (breadcrumbs / menu), the current view's actions, and global actions (notifications, profile).

not_to_confuse_with.why: Toolbar hosts a list/table's controls; the topbar is app chrome + view context
Page Header titles the content region; the topbar is the shell header
Breadcrumb is a part inside the topbar, not the bar itself

components.summary: A domain card summarizing a job vacancy — icon, title, status badge, meta, optional stats and assignees — used as a list unit that navigates to the detail.

not_to_confuse_with.why: Person Card is for people/candidates; Vacancy Card is for jobs
Kanban Card is a board tile in a column; Vacancy Card is a list row
Full Card is generic; Vacancy Card is the recruiting-domain unit
